test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence. If the sentence is already correct, select 'No substitution required'.

The principal of the college, along with the vice principals, *__have approved__* the new curriculum.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has approved**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence, "**The principal of the college, along with the vice principals**," is singular, as the primary subject is "**The principal**."
